items.question: What is the membership fee at Muscle Monster Gym?
items.answer: Membership is a fixed ₹600 per month. A one-time ₹500 registration fee applies when you join, so your first payment is ₹1,100.

items.question: Is the price negotiable?
items.answer: No. Muscle Monster Gym has one fixed price for every member — there is no bargaining at the counter.

items.question: Where is Muscle Monster Gym located?
items.answer: The gym is on Banjariya Road, Khalilabad, Uttar Pradesh.

items.question: Does the gym offer personal training?
items.answer: Yes. Owner-trainer Tahir offers one-on-one coaching alongside regular gym access.

items.question: What equipment is available?
items.answer: Free weights, benches, a squat rack, cardio machines and space for group training and stretching.

items.question: How do I contact the gym to join?
items.answer: Use the WhatsApp or call button on this page, or fill in the contact form, and the gym will get back to you.
